primitives.name: Island Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Recently posting OL charting: guard 1-on-1 pass-blocking island rates vs assignment-success percentile grades.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_{\\text{island}}': 'dimensionless ratio of 1-on-1 pass-blocking instances to total pass-blocking events'}
primitives.assumptions: Island rate reflects isolation of guard during pass protection, independent of team-wide scheme.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_{\text{island}} > 0.75, indicates high-risk pass-blocking scenario.

layer2.mapping: Island rate serves as a derived kernel for evaluating guard-specific risk in pass protection schemes.
layer2.telemetry: Guard-specific 1-on-1 pass-blocking frequency relative to total pass-blocking actions.

primitives.name: Assignment Success Percentile
primitives.verbatim_quote: Recently posting OL charting: guard 1-on-1 pass-blocking island rates vs assignment-success percentile grades.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{\\text{assign}}': 'percentile rank of guard’s pass-blocking success within positional cohort'}
primitives.assumptions: Percentile assumes normal distribution of guard performance across season.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_{\text{assign}} < 25, indicates below-average pass-blocking reliability.

layer2.mapping: Assignment success percentile acts as a kernel for quantifying guard proficiency in isolation scenarios.
layer2.telemetry: Guard’s percentile rank in pass-blocking success compared to peers.

primitives.name: Scheme Choice Island Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **SCHEME** (secondary): OL scheme observations (e.g., Giants' league-high island rates as a scheme choice).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_{\\text{scheme}}': 'average island rate across all guards in a given offensive line scheme'}
primitives.assumptions: Team-level scheme choice correlates with guard workload and risk exposure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_{\text{scheme}} > 0.80, suggests aggressive or high-risk pass protection strategy.

layer2.mapping: Scheme choice island rate mirrors team-level betting variance in high-island scenarios.
layer2.telemetry: Aggregate island rate per team’s pass-blocking scheme over multiple games.

primitives.name: Trust Signal Betting Process
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **TRUST-SIGNAL** (secondary): betting-process philosophy, tail-outcome identification — method for the engine's market lane, not player trust.
primitives.assumptions: Signal is derived from player performance metrics and betting variance analysis.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_{\text{signal}} < 0.3, indicates low confidence in market mispricing opportunity.

layer2.mapping: Trust signal maps to betting engine’s confidence in tail-outcome event probability.
layer2.telemetry: Probability-weighted betting signal derived from guard performance and scheme risk.
